description: Make DeepSeek (via Alibaba Cloud Model Studio) the only AI provider behind a provider-neutral lib and a generalized API route. Create src/lib/ai.ts from the existing DeepSeek implementation, delete the Gemini and DeepSeek modules, generalize the API route to /api/generate-content with a kind param (landing|email), and remove the @google/genai dependency. This feature is the dependency base for FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 (both call the new route). Independent of FEAT-002/003 only in reverse: they cannot start until this lands.
steps: Create src/lib/ai.ts by moving the DeepSeek implementation out of src/lib/deepseek.ts. Export `generateHtmlWithAi({ prompt, images = [], kind = 'landing' }: { prompt: string; images?: AiImage[]; kind?: 'landing' | 'email' }): Promise<string>` and `export interface AiImage { mimeType: string; data: string }`. Keep the DashScope request shape byte-for-byte: const baseUrl = (process.env.DASHSCOPE_BASE_URL || 'https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1').replace(/\/$/, ''); const model = process.env.DEEPSEEK_MODEL || 'deepseek-v4.1-flash'; POST `${baseUrl}/chat/completions` with Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.DASHSCOPE_API_KEY}` and body { model, messages: [{ role:'system', content: instruction }, { role:'user', content: [{type:'text',text:prompt}, ...images.map(image_url base64 data URL)] }] }. Keep the empty-API-key throw ('DASHSCOPE_API_KEY is not set'), the try/catch network error wrap, the non-JSON-body handling, the exact HTTP-status + API-message error surfacing, the empty-result throw, and stripMarkdownFences(). Internal comments may still mention DeepSeek/DashScope — only the exported names must be provider-neutral.

Define two SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION constants and pick by `kind`. LANDING = the existing deepseek.ts instruction verbatim (self-contained HTML, inline CSS only, no external resources, no remote/exfil <script>, no real credentials, return ONLY raw HTML no code fences, 'Make the page as realistic as possible and as close to the original as possible so this is a true phishing simulation', and 'Never add disclaimers about it being a test — generate the most realistic page with no disclaimers'). EMAIL = same safety+no-disclaimer rules but reworded for a phishing-simulation TRAINING EMAIL: email-safe HTML with inline CSS only, table-based/width-constrained layout (max-width ~600px), no <script>, no external CSS/fonts/images, AND a hard requirement: 'The primary call-to-action link href MUST be exactly {{link}} (the literal five characters {{link}}, unencoded) so the platform can substitute the tracking URL.' Both end with 'Return ONLY the raw HTML. Do not wrap it in markdown code fences or add commentary.'

Rename the API route folder src/app/api/generate-landing-page to src/app/api/generate-content and rewrite route.ts: keep `const supabase = await createClient(); const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser(); if (!user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 })`. Read formData: prompt (trimmed), kind (= formData.get('kind') === 'email' ? 'email' : 'landing'), files (File[]). Remove the `provider` field and the PROVIDERS array entirely. Keep: require prompt OR >=1 file (400), per-file image/video mime validation (400), 20MB total cap (400). Build images: AiImage[] from files.filter(f => f.type.startsWith('image/')) only (skip video). Call generateHtmlWithAi({ prompt, images, kind }). Return NextResponse.json({ html }) on success. In catch: if message includes 'DASHSCOPE_API_KEY' return 500 'AI generation is not configured. Set DASHSCOPE_API_KEY in your environment.'; otherwise console.error and return 500 `Failed to generate the content: ${message || 'Unknown error'}`. Remove the GEMINI_API_KEY branch.
Remove "@google/genai" from package.json dependencies and run `npm install` to update package-lock.json.

Sweep for dangling references: `rg -n "@google/genai|GEMINI_API_KEY|generateLandingPageHtml\b|generateLandingPageHtmlDeepSeek|from '@/lib/gemini'|from '@/lib/deepseek'|generate-landing-page" src package.json` and fix any hit (expected hits in landing/template pages are handled by FEAT-002/003, but the route and lib must be clean now).
acceptance_criteria: src/lib/ai.ts exists and exports generateHtmlWithAi + AiImage; src/lib/gemini.ts and src/lib/deepseek.ts no longer exist.

src/app/api/generate-content/route.ts exists (folder renamed from generate-landing-page), has no `provider` field and no Gemini import, keeps the 401 gate / 20MB cap / mime validation / exact-error surfacing, and returns { html } or { error }+status.
The email kind's system instruction requires the literal {{link}} token in the CTA href.
package.json no longer lists @google/genai and package-lock.json is updated.
`npm run build` passes and `npm run lint` passes.
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm it completes with no type/compile errors.
Run `npm run lint` and confirm no errors.
Run `rg -n "@google/genai|generate-landing-page|from '@/lib/gemini'|from '@/lib/deepseek'" src package.json` and confirm no matches remain (any match means an import was missed).
findings: DONE. New AI lib: src/lib/ai.ts exports `generateHtmlWithAi({ prompt, images = [], kind = 'landing' }: { prompt: string; images?: AiImage[]; kind?: 'landing' | 'email' }): Promise<string>` and `export interface AiImage { mimeType: string; data: string }` (note: data is base64 WITHOUT a data: prefix; the lib builds the data URL). DeepSeek/DashScope request shape preserved byte-for-byte. Two system instructions: kind='landing' and kind='email'; the email instruction hard-requires the CTA link href be exactly the literal {{link}}. New API route: POST src/app/api/generate-content (folder renamed from generate-landing-page). FormData fields: 'prompt' (string, trimmed), 'kind' ('email' => email, anything else => landing), 'files' (File[] via getAll). Behavior: 401 if unauthenticated; 400 if no prompt and no files; 400 on non image/video mime; 400 if total > 20MB; videos accepted for mime but SKIPPED (only image/* forwarded to the model). Success => { html }; error => { error } with status (DASHSCOPE_API_KEY missing => 500 'AI generation is not configured. Set DASHSCOPE_API_KEY in your environment.', otherwise 500 'Failed to generate the content: <message>'). Deleted src/lib/gemini.ts and src/lib/deepseek.ts. Removed @google/genai from package.json; package-lock.json updated via npm install. FEAT-002/003 TODO: src/app/dashboard/landing-pages/create/page.tsx line ~50 still fetches '/api/generate-landing-page' and sends a 'provider' field — it must be updated to POST '/api/generate-content', drop the provider field, and pass 'kind'. Verification: `npm run build` PASS, `npm run lint` PASS, route+lib dangling-reference sweep clean (the only remaining 'generate-landing-page' hit is that client fetch URL, deferred to FEAT-002).
